Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: onboarding enablement & recurring drop-in sessions for Acme Corp

Hi Marissa / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move forward. Before we get to integration, security wants a quick enablement plan and a regular cadence for drop-in office hours so our infra and app teams can get oriented. High level asks:

- Short recorded walkthroughs for API keys, rate limits, and embedding workflows
- A live session focused on VPC & SSO configuration (security team)
- A developer-focused integration deep-dive (our engineers)
- Weekly drop-in “open mic” office hours (30m) for the first 8 weeks

Can you propose a suggested schedule + owners? We also have a few early security questions around audit logs and data retention — happy to loop in legal/security as needed.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lin
Senior Engineering Manager
Acme Corp

Subject: Re: Request: onboarding enablement & recurring drop-in sessions for Acme Corp

Hi Sarah —

Great to hear. Suggested approach (high level):

1) Enablement sprint (three 60–75m sessions, recorded):
   - Session A: Platform overview, API + quickstart, common prompts & rate limits (Owner: Marissa)
   - Session B: Security & networking (SSO, VPC, audit logs) (Owner: Ben)
   - Session C: Integrations & embeddings deep-dive (Owner: Monica)

2) Weekly 30m drop-in hours (first 8 weeks) — Tuesdays 10:00 PT proposed. We'll record and publish notes.
3) Deliverables: short how-to videos, a runbook for SSO/VPC, and a shared FAQ/issue tracker.
4) Pre-work: we'll ask for environment details and a list of seats/owners; Sarah, if you can share any IP allowlists or compliance docs that helps.

I attached a rough outline (enablement-outline-v1.pdf). Ben / Monica / Lauren — can you confirm owners and availability for the week of Dec 7? I'll send calendar invites once we lock times.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

Attachment(s): enablement-outline-v1.pdf (application/pdf)
